about: Saved model fixes for the Building Regulations 2010 parser (system/rag/parse_legislation.py, ADR 0010). Keys are content fingerprints (system/rag/fixes.py). Checked blind: the model did not see the code's guesses; it agreed with all six.

fixes.target: Schedule 1 Part K, copy with K5.1-K5.4 and K6
fixes.reason: England's 2012 amendment (in force 6.4.2013) substituted this copy and moved the Part N glazing rules into Part K.
fixes.evidence: Note: substituted (E., but only in relation to excepted energy buildings in W.) (6.4.2013), S.I. 2012/3119
fixes.by: model check, Claude Code subagent, blind to code guess; code guess agreed

fixes.target: Schedule 1 Part K, copy with K1-K5
